item.title: CBS cameraman recalls 29 minutes capturing 9/11 at Ground Zero
item.description: CBS News cameraman Mark LaGanga filmed the 29 minutes between the towers falling on 9/11, continuing as the North Tower collapsed around him.

item.title: Iran strikes U.S. jets after Trump says war to end after midterms
item.description: Sources tell CBS News U.S. jets at a base in Jordan were hit by Iranian missiles after Trump said the war will end "immediately" after midterms.

item.title: Key takeaways from Trump's GOP midterm convention speech
item.description: At his party's biggest event, Trump placed himself at the center of the midterms, urging supporters to pretend "I'm on the ballot."

item.title: U.S. military aircraft damaged in Iranian strikes on Jordan base
item.description: One A-10 Thunderbolt, an attack aircraft known as the Warthog, was struck and lost a wing, according to sources.
